tagline: Forts, palaces and bazaars in Rajasthan's Pink City
signatureFood: dal baati churma, laal maas, pyaaz kachori, ghewar

seasons.label: Cool season
seasons.note: Best time to visit; pleasant for forts and walking. Winter mornings can be chilly.

seasons.label: Hot season
seasons.note: Very hot afternoons; plan sightseeing early morning and evening and keep midday indoors.

seasons.label: Monsoon
seasons.note: Humid with showers; the hills around Amber turn green but outdoor plans may get interrupted.

places.name: Amber Fort
places.desc: Hilltop Rajput fort with the Sheesh Mahal mirror palace and sweeping views over Maota Lake.

places.name: City Palace
places.desc: Royal residence mixing Rajput and Mughal architecture with museums of textiles, weapons and costumes.

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.desc: Iconic five-storey pink sandstone facade with 953 small windows; best photographed in morning light.

places.name: Jantar Mantar
places.desc: UNESCO-listed 18th-century observatory with giant stone instruments, including the world's largest stone sundial.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset
places.desc: Hill fort overlooking Jaipur, famous for sunset views and a rooftop cafe scene.

places.name: Jaigarh Fort
places.desc: Fortress above Amber that houses Jaivana, one of the world's largest cannons on wheels.

places.name: Albert Hall Museum
places.desc: Indo-Saracenic museum with a collection of carpets, miniature paintings, sculptures and an Egyptian mummy.

places.name: Johari and Bapu Bazaar
places.desc: Busy walled-city markets for lac bangles, gemstones, block-printed fabrics, mojari shoes and Rajasthani handicrafts.

places.name: Chokhi Dhani Rajasthani Village Dinner
places.desc: Ethnic village resort with folk music, dance, puppet shows, camel rides and an unlimited Rajasthani thali.

places.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB) Meal
places.desc: Century-old vegetarian restaurant known for Rajasthani sweets, kachori and thalis.

places.name: Panna Meena ka Kund Stepwell
places.desc: Geometric 16th-century stepwell near Amber that is a favourite with photographers and is free to enter.

places.name: Jal Mahal Viewpoint
places.desc: Quick photo stop at the lake palace that appears to float on Man Sagar Lake.

places.name: Hot Air Balloon Ride over Amber
places.desc: Sunrise balloon flight over Amber Fort and the Aravalli foothills, subject to weather.
